sourceNotes.rawContent: Enhance your traditional charm with this exquisite gold-toned floral nath. Featuring a cluster of shimmering white stones and a graceful teardrop drop, this high-fashion piece is perfect for celebrations. To maintain its radiant golden luster, keep it away from moisture and perfumes, and store it safely after use.
